title: Manifest
description:
The parsed and validated form of a widget's `manifest.json`.
The canonical loader is [`Manifest::from_str`] (and [`Manifest::from_reader`]);
They enforce both the JSON Schema-expressible constraints (via the underlying `RawManifest` deserialize)
and the cross-field invariants the schema cannot describe.

binary.description: Path to the widget binary, relative to the widget's directory.

category.description: Catalog grouping for the Add-widget picker. Defaults to [`WidgetCategory::Misc`].

config_help.description:
Optional Markdown shown in the operator's widget-config window: a
preface above the parameter fields, and the sole content when the
widget declares no parameters. Capped at 2000 characters.

credentials.description:
Credential slots the operator binds a saved account to, keyed by [`CredentialKey`].
Iteration order matches manifest order.

description.description:
One-line widget description, shown in the operator UI.
Capped at 200 characters.

icon.description: Optional icon path, relative to the widget dir or absolute. Served by BMC.

name.description:
Human-readable widget name, shown in the operator UI.
Capped at 50 characters.

params.description:
Per-instance parameter declarations, keyed by [`ParamKey`].
Iteration order matches manifest order.

settings.description:
System-provided settings the widget wants injected (locale, timezone, night mode, etc.).
Order is preserved.

subname.description:
Optional short secondary label, shown grayed beside `name`.
Capped at 30 characters.

supported_viewports.description: Viewport families this widget supports. Must be non-empty.

uid.description:
Stable unique identifier — must be UUID version 4. Used to distinguish widgets at runtime;
never reused once a widget is published.

Author.description: Optional author block on a manifest, surfaced in the operator UI.

name.description: Author name, as shown in the operator UI.

url.description: Optional link to a project page or organisation site.

CredentialSlot.description:
One credential slot a widget declares: which kind of account it accepts, and how the operator
sees it in the picker.

description.description:
Help text shown under the picker, for a slot whose label leaves something unsaid.
Optional on purpose: requiring it only buys descriptions that restate the label.

label.description:
Operator-facing slot label, shown beside the account picker.
Must not be blank, and is capped like the widget's own name
— it reaches the editor's picker unabridged.

required.description:
Whether the widget cannot work without this slot bound.

Defaults to true: an omitted key means the author did not consider it,
and the cautious reading warns an operator about an unbound slot
rather than staying silent.

type.description:
Id of the credential type this slot accepts,
from the firmware catalog ([`credential::builtins`]).

DoubleOption.description:
A single entry in a `ParamKind::Double` `enum_values` list.
The `value` is the f64 selected; `label` is the operator-facing string.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the operator UI.

value.description:
Wire value stored for this option.
Must be finite and unique within the surrounding `enum_values` array after canonicalising
`+0.0` and `-0.0` to the same bit pattern.

IntegerOption.description: A single entry in a `ParamKind::Integer` `enum_values` list.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the operator UI.

value.description:
Wire value stored for this option.
Must be unique within the surrounding `enum_values` array.

ParamDefinition.description:
Per-field declaration inside a schema's field map.
The `kind` field carries the value-type-specific options (`enum_values`, `min`, `max`, etc.)
via a serde-flattened tagged enum.

description.description: Optional one-line field description, shown in the operator UI as help text.

name.description: Human-readable field name, shown in the operator UI.

optional.description:
Whether the operator can leave this field unset.
Optional fields may have a default; required fields *must* (and the host always delivers a value).

default_value.description:
Initial value seeded at widget creation; later updates with the operator field unset are delivered as `Null`.
Required when `optional == false`. Capped at [`MAX_PARAM_STRING_LENGTH`] bytes.

enum_values.description:
Optional closed set of allowed values.
When non-empty, the `default_value` must be one of these.

format.description: Optional structural hint to the operator UI.

default_value.description:
Initial value seeded at widget creation; later updates with the operator field unset are delivered as `Null`.
Required when `optional == false`.

enum_values.description:
Optional closed set of allowed values.
When non-empty, the `default_value` must be one of these.

oneOf.description: A 32-bit signed integer — JSON Schema "integer" with i32 range.

default_value.description:
Initial value seeded at widget creation; later updates with the operator field unset are delivered as `Null`.
Required when `optional == false`.

enum_values.description:
Optional closed set of allowed values.
When non-empty, the `default_value` must be one of these.

default_value.description:
Initial value seeded at widget creation; later updates with the operator field unset are delivered as `Null`.
Required when `optional == false`.

oneOf.description:
An IANA timezone identifier. Wire form is a string;
the dedicated variant lets the operator UI render a zone picker instead of a free-form text input.

default_value.description:
Initial zone seeded at widget creation; later updates with the operator field unset are delivered as `Null`.
Required when `optional == false`. Capped at [`MAX_PARAM_STRING_LENGTH`] bytes.

SettingKey.description:
System-provided settings a widget can request, listed in the manifest's `settings` array.
Each variant names a category the host injects automatically — the widget does not declare these as params.

oneOf.description: Locale and language settings — the widget receives the configured locale on start.
Time zone settings — the widget receives the configured zone on start and on change.

StringFormat.description:
Optional structural hint on a `ParamKind::String`, instructing
the operator UI to render a specialised input (date picker, URI validator, etc.) instead of a free-form text field.

oneOf.description: Sensitive value the UI must mask (render a password input, never echo the value back).

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the operator UI.

value.description:
Wire value stored for this option.
Must be unique within the surrounding `enum_values` array and non-empty after trim.
Capped at [`MAX_PARAM_STRING_LENGTH`] bytes.

ViewportShape.description: Visible viewport shape a widget viewport constraint targets.

WidgetCategory.description:
Catalog grouping a widget belongs to, used by the Add-widget picker to
section the list. A widget declares exactly one; the field defaults to
[`WidgetCategory::Misc`] when absent.

oneOf.description: Miner, fleet, and pool / network mining stats.
Sports results, standings, and live timing.

WidgetViewportConstraint.description:
A viewport family a widget author declares support for. Ranges are
inclusive on both ends; `None` means unbounded in that direction, while
`min_* == max_*` pins one exact value.

max_height.description: Inclusive maximum height in pixels, or unbounded.

max_width.description: Inclusive maximum width in pixels, or unbounded.

min_height.description: Inclusive minimum height in pixels, or unbounded.

min_width.description: Inclusive minimum width in pixels, or unbounded.
